headline: Stellantis Extends Shutdown of Ontario Plant Amid Automotive Market Pressures
summary: Automaker Stellantis extended its temporary operational shutdown at its assembly plant in Windsor, Ontario, citing evolving market conditions and trade tariff pressures.
why: Stellantis is one of the world's largest vehicle manufacturers, and its Windsor facility is a major Canadian auto manufacturing hub.

impacts.name: Stellantis N.V.
impacts.why: Extended plant shutdowns delay production output and highlight softening vehicle demand.
